acceptanceCriteria: One lane runs dogfood-finish and batch-check PASS in a linked worktree, with the receipt retained.
docs/LANE-ORCHESTRATION.md and the charter switch to worktrees, or record the exact blocker.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the lane-hygiene lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1107, head b04b5b61d, ASD-V0-013..018). Expected: lanes use one linked worktree per lane from a shared repository, which DCW-V0-044 supports (TestDogfoodDCWV0044WorktreeLanesRunConcurrently). Actual: the orchestrator charter still requires a fresh plain clone per lane; a live dogfood-finish in a linked worktree was NOT_RUN.
title: Live-qualify worktree lanes for dogfood and retire the plain-clone lane rule
